name: Creepyville
about: Our own small foggy town where every CreepyCartoonTales story happens: old houses, one clock tower, a lake, a forest, a closed amusement park. Same town, same places, every day; it grows by itself.

locations.town_square_night: the town square at night, an old stone clock tower showing nearly three o'clock, closed shops with dark windows, wet cobblestones, fog, one flickering street lamp
locations.main_street_day: a small-town main street on a grey afternoon, old shop fronts with plain blank awnings and no signs, parked cars, power lines, autumn leaves on the pavement
locations.police_station_night: the outside of a small-town police station at night, two police cars parked in front, blue and red light reflecting on wet ground, a lit glass door
locations.police_station_inside: inside a small-town police station at night, a front desk with an old computer, a bench, a notice board, a flickering ceiling light, an empty corridor to the cells
locations.school_hallway_night: an empty school hallway at night, rows of metal lockers, one locker door slightly open, emergency exit light glowing green, a long shiny floor
locations.classroom_day: a school classroom on a rainy afternoon, wooden desks, a chalkboard, a clock on the wall, a window with rain
locations.park_night: a town park at night, empty swings, a pond reflecting the moon, a bench under a lamp post, tall dark trees, mist on the grass
locations.park_day: a sunny town park, green grass, a pond with ducks, benches, a winding path, a small fountain, cheerful but slightly too quiet
locations.playground_night: an empty children's playground at night, a slide, a roundabout, one swing still moving, a single lamp, fog
locations.parking_lot_night: a large outdoor car park at night, many parked cars in rows, tall lamp posts with orange light, puddles, one car's headlights on
locations.gas_station_night: a lonely roadside gas station at night, glowing canopy lights, two fuel pumps, a small shop with a neon window, empty road, forest behind
locations.diner_night: inside a 24-hour roadside diner at night, red booths, a long counter with stools, a coffee pot, a window showing the dark empty road
locations.supermarket_aisle_night: a supermarket aisle late at night, long shelves of colourful products, harsh white lights, one light flickering at the far end, no people
locations.hospital_corridor_night: a hospital corridor at night, pale green walls, a wheelchair by the wall, doors with small windows, a flickering tube light at the end
locations.graveyard_night: an old graveyard at night, leaning gravestones, a twisted tree, an iron gate, a full moon, low fog over the grass
locations.old_church_night: an old wooden church on a hill at night, a tall bell tower, broken stained glass glowing faintly, a gravel path, crows on the roof
locations.forest_path_night: a narrow path through a dark pine forest at night, moonlight beams through the trees, mist, roots across the path
locations.lake_dock_night: a wooden dock on a calm black lake at night, a small rowing boat tied up, the moon reflected in the water, forest on the far shore
locations.amusement_park_night: a closed old amusement park at night, a tall wooden roller coaster loop against the sky, a dark ferris wheel, ticket booth, string lights half broken
locations.train_station_night: a small empty train station platform at night, a bench, a station clock, rails disappearing into fog, a single yellow lamp
locations.bus_stop_night: a bus stop on an empty road at night in the rain, a glass shelter with a timetable, a street lamp, reflections on the wet road
locations.library_night: inside an old town library at night, tall wooden shelves, a reading table with a green lamp, moonlight from a high window, dust
locations.basement_night: a cluttered house basement, a bare light bulb hanging from a cord, a boiler, old boxes, wooden stairs going up into darkness
locations.attic_night: a dusty attic under a sloped roof, old trunks, a rocking chair, a round window with moonlight, cobwebs
locations.elevator_inside: inside an old apartment elevator, metal walls, a panel of buttons, a flickering ceiling light, the doors closed
locations.rooftop_night: the flat rooftop of an apartment building at night, water tanks, an antenna, the lights of the town below, a cloudy sky with the moon
locations.bridge_fog_night: an old iron bridge over a river at night, thick fog, lamp posts fading into the mist, no cars
locations.barn_night: an old red farm barn at night, the big door half open, hay bales, a lantern glowing inside, a cornfield behind
locations.laundromat_night: Rows of circular washing machines hum beneath flickering green fluorescent tubes, casting eerie aquatic reflections across soapy checkered linoleum in a silent, liminal haze.
locations.greenhouse_fog_day: An overgrown Victorian glass solarium tangled with enormous potted monsteras and suspicious hanging vines, illuminated by milky overcast daylight diffusing through cracked glass panes with humid, comic suspense.
locations.antique_shop_day: Pale shafts of sunlight cut through floating dust motes onto cluttered shelves packed with grandfather clocks, bizarre music boxes, and silent porcelain figurines.
locations.bowling_alley_night: Flickering neon signs and purple blacklight cast eerie glows across empty polished lanes, where a single glowing pin waits at the end of the shadowy floor.
